reason: The image-only reading gave disconnected letter groups at about 50 px a line; with the psalm text beside the images the groups resolve into consecutive lines and several misread words (creaturen, ulammende, confirmatie) are corrected to crachten, versamenden, vergaderinghe.
sources: N. van Wijk, Het getijdenboek van Geert Grote naar het Haagse handschrift 133 E 21, Leiden 1940, pp. 46-47 and 192 (DBNL transcription; Google Books snippets of volume lvdZAAAAIAAJ)
Psalmen, Bijbelvertaling van 1360, Ps 149:1-4, in the Corpus Middelnederlands (Instituut voor de Nederlandse Taal), https://corpusmiddelnederlands.ivdnt.org/
Gebedenboek uit de kring van de Moderne Devotie, Ps 149-150, in the Corpus Middelnederlands (second witness of the same translation)
text:
F-xukl - SOURCE-ASSISTED reading (made with Van Wijk's edition of Geert Grote's Getijdenboek, pp. 46-47, in the DBNL transcription beside the images). Reread by a research reader on 5x enlargements of the native images, 12 October 2026: fol. [2]r lines 3-12, fol. [2]v lines 3-12, fol. [1]r lines 7-12, fol. [1]v lines 2 and 5-12. Other lines not reread. Not an independent reading; a script line is about 50 px high and minims cannot be divided. Accuracy not measured.
Conventions: only letters visible on the strips are given; every line is cut on one or both sides. [ ] = lost at the cut and supplied from the edition; (..) = expansion; (?) = uncertain; | = cut between the two strips. Line numbers count the twelve surviving lines from the top of each face.
